modules.responsibility: Pure deterministic C# game logic shared with the Unity client (ADR-10). UPM package com.rpgmmo.shared-gamelogic.
rules: Targets netstandard2.1;net10.0. No Unity/ECS/Arch types, no server code, no reflection. NativeAOT compatible.

Behaviour change -> regenerate golden vectors and commit fixtures in the same change.
Release = package.json version bump in the same commit; the sgl-vX.Y.Z tag is created by the lead, never by an agent.

modules.responsibility: C# .NET 10 authoritative game server: combat, movement, world state, AOI. NativeAOT published.
rules: XML doc comments on public APIs; no allocations in hot paths; NativeAOT-safe (System.Text.Json source generators, no reflection).
Tests needing docker/Postgres/Redis use [SkippableFact] / SkipUnlessAvailable(), never an early return. Deadlines use Stopwatch, not DateTime.UtcNow.
Movement-related changes need a test through the live socket path (pattern: GameServer.Tests/Server/SlowClientMovementTests.cs).

Deterministic logic the client must reproduce or predict (movement, combat, validation, content rules) goes into Shared.GameLogic and the game server calls it; never put it only in GameServer/ (ADR-10).
Redis hash servers:id:{id} is a cross-language contract with Go redisstore/registry.go.

Knobs: a new GAMESERVER_* const (ServerEnv.cs / *Settings) is reflected by GameServer.Tests/Deploy/DeclaredKnobs.cs and must be passed through in docker-compose.yml + docker-compose.override.yml and agones/fleet-map-dotnet-dev.yaml + k8s/app/50-fleet-map.yaml + k8s/app/60-fleet-dungeon.yaml (or excluded by name with a reason) - Compose/FleetEnvPassthroughTests fail otherwise. k8s/app/20-configmaps.yaml is not what those tests read.
Metrics: new instruments in Observability/GameMetrics.cs are documented in docs/METRICS.md (no test enforces this - review item).

Systems implement IEcsSystem with Group, unique Order and complete ComponentAccess (structural if spawn/reap); no mutable instance fields except [SimulationScratch] (SimulationStateArchitectureTests).
New component type -> World/ArchAotHints.cs line in the same commit (ArchAotHintTests). No CommandBuffer (ADR-11/12).
CLI args are space-separated (`--addr :9000`); the `--addr=:9000` form shown in root and gameserver CLAUDE.md is silently ignored (GetArg, Program.cs).
